title: LingoLeap Lesson Content Schema v2
description: Validates the content standardization fields defined in docs/specs/content-schema-2026-05-09.md (Refs #1509). Covers learning_goal, lesson_intro, step_sequence, and intro_step_count.

learning_goal.description: Teacher-filled learning goal statement shown on the Intro page 'Learning Goal' banner. Null when teacher has not yet filled. NOT auto-parsed from docx.
examples: 學習透過「圖文比對」策略，整合文字與圖表資訊，精確回答說明文問題
counterexamples: 巴斯德鵝頸瓶實驗的設計與程序

lesson_intro.description: Course introduction shown on the Intro page 'Course Introduction' section. Auto-parsed from docx explanation or guide sections, or from Excel strategy table. Distinct from learning_goal: describes what the lesson is about (background), not what the student will learn to do.

source.description: Provenance of the intro text. 'ai_generated' reserved for post-7/1 batch generation.

text.description: The narrative intro text shown to students. Should read as a paragraph, not a strategy code tag.

unit_topic.description: Optional topic tag from Excel strategy table (e.g. '運動+運動家精神').

strategy_title.description: Optional strategy name from Excel (e.g. '自我提問'). Not shown directly to students — used for filtering.

examples.text: 圖文題在近年會考國文科的比重大幅增加——114年會考圖文題有9題，但十年前（105年）的會考卻只有1題。圖文題就是「文字帶著插圖」的題目，你不能只看文字，也不能只看插圖，眼睛必須在文字和插圖中來回移動，把文圖之間的關係弄清楚，才能又快又正確地答題。這一課我們就用一個科學史上有名的實驗，來學習如何閱讀、解答圖文題。
本課探討「品格-堅毅」主題，學習「自我提問」的閱讀方法。

step_sequence.description: Per-lesson override of the default digital step order. Null means use DEFAULT_STEP_SEQUENCE (11 enabled steps). Values must be valid step IDs from STEP_REGISTRY in stepConfig.ts.

intro_step_count.description: ESCAPE HATCH ONLY. Override the computed digital step count shown on Intro page as '本課 N 個學習步驟'. Null (recommended) means compute from resolveActiveSteps(). Do NOT set to paper worksheet section count — that was the 5/8 bug. Only needed if display label must differ from actual step count.

content: This schema validates only the 3 fields defined in spec #1509.
It does NOT validate the full lesson YAML (see lesson-content-v1 or the Pydantic StoryDetail schema in backend/app/schemas/story.py).
Use with ajv or jsonschema: extract only the 4 keys from each YAML before validating.
lesson_intro.source='ai_generated' is reserved for post-7/1 batch generation and should trigger educator review label in admin UI.
intro_step_count should remain null for all lessons unless there is a specific display override requirement.
